cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I crossed out the dress price like the shop assistant. Ten pounds to borrow it, plus an apology for calling it hideous.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She crossed out a price because the zip was broken. Is yours broken too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, condition checked. The zip works. Ten pounds, and say you were wrong about my taste.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's twenty. I'll tell everyone tonight that you chose it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep ten. Tell them you laughed when I chose it, too. I want the compliment with its history attached.
